services.name: Open Swim
services.desc: Five Star Swim School's facilities are open to everyone who wishes to swim, exercise, or simply relax and enjoy our heated indoor swimming pool. It is a safe place to bring your family and have fun. Our facilities offer swimming and exercise equipment and locker rooms with showers, changing stations, lockers, and hair dryers. A poolside lifeguard is on duty during Open Swim hours for your safety. There is no Swim Class during the Open Swim. Open Swim schedule and price vary per location. services.name: Trial class
services.desc: Come see what makes Five Star Swim School special! Your free trial class is a full, 30-minute swim lesson, just like our regular classes. It’s a great way for your family to explore our facility, meet our friendly instructors, and see how we help little swimmers build confidence in the water. After your lesson, our team will talk with you about your child’s skills, recommend the best level, and help you find a class time that fits your schedule. Ready? Get started Today!
